AGENDA
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MAY 11, 2022
UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF
ASSEMBLY BILL 361, WHICH ALLOWS PLANNING COMMISSION MEMBERS TO PARTICIPATE FROM A
REMOTE LOCATION WITHOUT LISTING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS DURING A
MEETING: YOU MAY ATTEND THE MEETING, SEND AN EMAIL TO: planning@norwalkca.gov OR JOIN
THE ZOOM MEETING BY CALLING 1-(408) 638-0968 OR USING THE ZOOM APP; MEETING ID: 895 8662
1054 DURING THE MEETING TO SPEAK ON AN ITEM. THE MEETING MAY BE VIEWED ON FIOS
CHANNEL 32 OR CHARTER CHANNEL 3 OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT: https://www.norwalk.org/city-
hall/meeting-agendas-393.
  6:00 PM
  SPECIAL MEETING
  NORWALK CITY HALL/COUNCIL CHAMBERS

  AND VIA TELECONFERENCE
  Kim Apodaca, Chair
  Linda Lopez, Vice Chair
  Rosa Barragan, Planning Commissioner
  Gabriel P. Garcia, Planning Commissioner
  Luis Navas, Planning Commissioner
  Public Comment: The public is encouraged to address Planning Commission on any matter listed on the agenda or on any
  other matter within its jurisdiction subject to the rules of decorum described in Section 2.08.020 of the Norwalk Municipal
  Code. If you wish to address Planning Commission, please complete the card that is provided at the rear entrance to
  Council Chambers and hand the card to the Secretary. Planning Commission will hear public comment on items listed on
  the agenda during discussion of the matter and prior to a vote. Planning Commission will hear public comment on matters
  not listed on the agenda during the Oral Communications period.

  Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
  certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The Planning Commission may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule
  certain matters for consideration at a future Planning Commission meeting.

  Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Planning Commission:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the Planning Commission as a whole and not directed to individual Planning
  Commission members.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
  meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the Secretary's office, (562) 929-5744. Assisted listening
  devices are available at this meeting. Ask the Secretary if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
  documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
  Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
  that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

  Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the Planning Commission regarding any item on this agenda
  after it has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

  Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
  during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
  telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e?mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.
 Notice of Special Meeting

CALL TO ORDER

FLAG SALUTE Commissioner Barragan

ROLL CALL OF MEMBERS
  UNFINISHED BUSINESS

  1.  PRECISE DEVELOPMENT PLAN (PDP) NO. 2035 CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT (CUP) NO. 1026
  NOTICE OF CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION (CLASS 3)
  John Clay, Red Mountain Group ("Applicant") on behalf of SuperStar Carwash; PDP: a request to
  demolish an existing multi-tenant commercial building and construct a new 3,819 square foot
  automated carwash facility with self-service vacuums; CUP: a request to permit a carwash facility at
  11042 Rosecrans Avenue; Assessor’s Parcel Number("APN") 8075-009-021 in the Restricted
  Commercial (C-1) zone.
  Staff Recommendation: That the Planning Commission:

  1)  Adopt Resolution No. 22-02 denying Precise Development Plan No. 2035 and

  2)  Adopt Resolution No. 22-03 denying Conditional Use Permit No. 1026.

  Staff Report 5-11-22

  Attachment A - Reso to deny PDP

  Attachment B - Reso to deny CUP

  Staff Report 4-27-22

  CONTINUED PUBLIC HEARING
  2. ZONING ORDINANCE TEXT AMENDMENT (ZTA) NO. 321
  PRECISE DEVELOPMENT PLAN (PDP) NO. 2038
  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT (CUP) NO. 1030
  DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (DA)
  NOTICE OF CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION (CLASS 1)
  Ryan Kelleher, CenterPoint Properties Trust ("Applicant"); 11729 Imperial Highway; Assessor’s
  Parcel Number ("APN") 8023-026-040, in the General Commercial (C-3) zone. The applicant requests
  to operate a last-mile delivery facility or an online automobile dealership distribution facility on the
  project site. The applications involve the following:

  1)  ZTA: To add a definition for "Last-Mile Delivery facility", amend the definition of "vehicle sales" to
  include online sales, establish standards for last-mile delivery facility in the C-3 zone.

  2)  PDP: To install five (5) dock doors and associated truck wells on the south side of the existing
  building, four (4) grade level doors for van access, and related site and landscaping
  improvements.

  3)  CUP: To permit an online automobile sales use on the site.

  4)  DA: To specify the terms and community wide benefits of the project.
  Staff Recommendation:
  The Planning Commission has the following options:
  Last-Mile Delivery Facility

  a)  Adopt Resolution No. 22-XX to recommend approval of Zoning Ordinance Text Amendment
  No. 321 and Development Agreement to City Council; and approve Precise Development Plan
  No. 2038, subject to the Conditions of Approval contained in “Exhibit A” of the resolution;

  b)  Adopt Resolution No. 22-XX to deny Zoning Ordinance Text Amendment No. 321,
  Development Agreement, and Precise Development Plan No. 2038;
  Online Automobile Dealership
   c)  Adopt Resolution No. 22-XX to recommend approval of Zoning Ordinance Text Amendment
  No. 321 and Development Agreement to City Council; approve Precise Development Plan No.
  2038 and Conditional Use Permit No. 1030, subject to the Conditions of Approval contained in
  "Exhibit A" of the resolution;

  d)  Adopt Resolution No 22-__ to deny Zoning Ordinance Text Amendment No. 321,
  Development Agreement, and Precise Development Plan No. 2038;

  e)  Continue the project and direct staff accordingly.

  Staff Report

  Attachment A - Reso to approve

  Attachment B - Reso to deny

  Attachment C - Resolution to aprove

  Attachment D - Reso to deny

  Attachment E - Location & Zoning Map

  Attachment F - Project Plans

  Attachment G - Noise Impact Analysis

  Attachment H - Trip Generation Memo

  Attachment I - Operational Air Quality Reort

  Attachment J - Categorical Exemption

  Attachment K - Draft Ordinance

  Attachment L - Draft Development Agreement

  Attachment M - Public Comments in Support

  Attachment N - Public Comments in Opposition

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated May 6, 2022.

John P. Ramirez, AICP
Director of Community Development/Secretary
